ItemID: Bends; Title: Bends; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for heavier music right now; this feels less aligned with my recent listening.
ItemID: God Hates Us All; Title: God Hates Us All Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The aggression fits my heavier interests, but I would choose more melodic or progressive material this time.
ItemID: Hybrid Theory; Title: Hybrid Theory; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavy riffs and melodic hooks fit my taste, but Tool is my stronger interest today.
ItemID: Lateralus; Title: Lateralus; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: After 10.000 Days, I would want more of Tool's intricate rhythms and immersive songs.
ItemID: Kid A; Title: Kid A; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its electronic and atmospheric direction is less appealing than heavy guitar music right now.
ItemID: Toxicity; Title: Toxicity; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The forceful riffs, rhythmic shifts, and melodic passages fit my interest in intense but distinctive music.
ItemID: Aenima; Title: Aenima Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: My recent interest in Tool makes another album of their heavy, progressive sound an easy choice.
ItemID: Room for Squares; Title: Room for Squares; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its mellow pop sound does not match the heavier albums I am interested in today.
ItemID: Korn; Title: Korn Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavy grooves appeal to me, but I would prioritize Tool and Toxicity on this visit.
ItemID: Brave New World; Title: Brave New World; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic metal sound fits some of my listening, but it is a weaker immediate choice than the albums I selected.
